description: The standard visual components. A metric names one; the frontend builds each once, with every data state from the design doc (loading, empty, dormant, too little history, data incomplete, error).

visuals.name: KPI tile
visuals.use: One number with its change and period
rules: One value, one change, one sub-line
Change colour follows the metric's good direction
Tooltip shows the catalog definition

visuals.name: KPI group
visuals.use: 2 or 3 related values side by side, such as revenue windows
rules: Same unit across the group
Each value names its window

visuals.name: Band cards
visuals.use: Count per risk band with a size split
rules: Band shown by label and colour, never colour alone
Share of scored operators under the count

visuals.name: Movement table
visuals.use: Tier movement between two snapshots
rules: Rows are bands; columns current, last month, retained, new, net
Net coloured by good direction

visuals.name: Transition matrix
visuals.use: Operators moving between bands
rules: Rows are last month's band, columns this month's
Diagonal muted; every cell opens the filtered queue

visuals.name: Carry-over table
visuals.use: Operators flagged in both snapshots by size, plus new entrants
rules: Size columns follow the size filter
New entrants in their own column

visuals.name: Lost operators card
visuals.use: Operators flagged High last month that stopped buying
rules: Shows Provisional until the month matures
Size split under the total

visuals.name: Monthly bars
visuals.use: 12 months of one measure
rules: Last 3 months highlighted
Optional second row for a related count
Value on hover; axis starts at zero

visuals.name: Trend line
visuals.use: A measure across snapshots or months
rules: At most 3 series
Model or feature version changes marked on the axis

visuals.name: Price chart
visuals.use: Agreement price against peers and list
rules: Agreement solid, peer average thin, list dashed
List line only when a real list price exists

visuals.name: Presence grid
visuals.use: Which product lines were bought each month
rules: One colour per line, stable across screens
Legend under the grid

visuals.name: Bar list
visuals.use: Ranked categories with a count or value
rules: Sorted descending
Each row clickable to the filtered queue

visuals.name: Progress bar
visuals.use: A share with its numerator and denominator
rules: Shows both counts, not only the percent

visuals.name: Freshness strip
visuals.use: Snapshot, latest data and scoring dates
rules: Amber when older than policy
Never implies a daily feed

visuals.name: State strip
visuals.use: Counts by data state
rules: Each state labelled; dormant and incomplete never hidden

visuals.name: State badge
visuals.use: One operator's data state
rules: Text plus icon; shown wherever the operator appears

visuals.name: Verdict card
visuals.use: Top of the operator workspace
rules: Band, score, exposure, last activity, owner, one-line reason
Reporting caveat inside the card when below policy

visuals.name: Three-level signal table
visuals.use: Operator, line and product signals together
rules: One row per level; never an averaged score
Counts labelled as counts

visuals.name: Reasons panel
visuals.use: The explanation and its states
rules: Summary, 3 or 4 reasons, caveat, feedback buttons
Pending and unavailable show the summary from the data

visuals.name: Driver chart
visuals.use: What raised and lowered the risk
rules: Signed bars with strength words, not raw SHAP values
Raises risk and lowers risk in separate groups

visuals.name: Recency gauge
visuals.use: How late the next order is
rules: On schedule, late and very late zones labelled in words
Months or days, as configured

visuals.name: Ranked table
visuals.use: Queues and lists of operators, lines or products
rules: Sortable headers with aria-sort
Rows focusable and opened with Enter
Server-side paging at 50 rows; CSV export

visuals.name: Peer position
visuals.use: Their price, peers' price and the difference
rules: Up arrow means they pay more than peers
Peer group, size and widened flag shown underneath

visuals.name: Peer price table
visuals.use: Lowest, highest and average peer price per line, as numbers
rules: Plain column names
Peer count per row
Paired with the peer price spread chart behind one switch

visuals.name: Peer price spread
visuals.use: The spread of peer prices per line, with this operator's own price marked
rules: One row per line; each row scaled to its own prices, never a shared axis across lines
Every peer drawn as a dot, so a small peer group is visible rather than implied
Box and median only when the peer count reaches the quartile threshold; below it, dots and range only, labelled
Their price marked distinctly and coloured by the same above/below rule as the table
Paired with the peer price table behind one switch

visuals.name: Chip list
visuals.use: Short sets of items, such as lines peers buy
rules: Each chip states its share of peers

visuals.name: Caveat banner
visuals.use: Reporting may be incomplete
rules: Amber, plain words, appears only below policy

visuals.name: Review control
visuals.use: Record status and disposition
rules: Disposition from a fixed list plus optional note
Writes are idempotent and append-only

visuals.name: Status pill
visuals.use: Buying, Buying less, Stopped and similar labels
rules: Text label always visible

visuals.name: Simple table
visuals.use: Small reference tables
rules: No more than 8 rows without paging
